title: Im interested in ai coding, where to start?
author: Alissah
selftext:
Hello, ive been a programmer for about 9 years, and im currently a hobbyist game dev.

Im looking for an ai that can see and understand my projecf, and write an occasional function or fix a bug or two. Im not looking to “vibe code” entire projects or anything.

I am willing to spend a little money, but id prefer to be able to start with a free trial or something like that.

Ive always supported ai tools and such, but I’ve honestly never looked into proper ai coding myself… So its time to get with the times. Im very much not up to date with what people are using and whats good or not.

So, whats everyones favorite options?
